mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the handset against the local controller was most worthwhile: it demonstrated a working connection without the corporate uplink while stating the test's narrow scope.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the documented software was a straightforward setup step, with little decision-making beyond choosing the obvious matching pieces.

surprise.text: Replacing the radio also revealed that the portable controller depended on a workshop socket, so a working local network was not yet a portable one.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the repairs and record comparisons had clear purposes.

continue.text: I would continue: the verified cutoff creates a concrete problem, and I would like to see whether the limited local network can help the neighborhood respond.
